name: xc7k325t
comment: AMD/Xilinx Kintex-7 XC7K325T (FFG900, KC705-class) — OpenXC7/nextpnr-xilinx 靶機。envelope = datasheet numbers (DS180); clb/routing timing and R/C are logical-model estimates for efc's grid P&R, NOT silicon-accurate values. 7-series CLB = 2 slices x (4 LUT6 + 8 FF) = 8 LUT6 + 16 FF, same shape as the vp1902 logical model, so pack/fabric/place/route run unchanged.
